children: Sermonix Pharmaceuticals, Inc. disclosed a 36.9% beneficial stake in LeonaBio, Inc. common stock. On Aug. 24, 2026, the company became eligible to exercise prefunded warrants tied to a prior collaboration, with related exercises and transfers set to take effect on Oct. 26, 2026. The position arises from a licensing deal and includes a large warrant exercise, distributions in kind, and an assignment to a creditor.

Sermonix acquired the securities as part of a strategic collaboration with LeonaBio under a License Agreement and a Securities Purchase Agreement. The company stated, “The acquisition of securities of the issuer is part of a strategic collaboration,” and noted that its prefunded warrant “was previously subject to an exercise cap equal to 4.99%.”

Sermonix plans several steps effective Oct. 26, 2026: exercise warrants for 3,149,470 shares, distribute 4,725,754 shares in kind (including 2,352,932 assigned to Perceptive Xontogeny Venture Fund II, LP), and assign 170,940 shares to a creditor to settle amounts owed.

Sermonix Pharmaceuticals, Inc. is a Delaware corporation focused on pharmaceutical intellectual property licensing and clinical development. The company, led by CEO David Portman, centers its efforts on advancing therapies such as lasofoxifene. Sermonix partners with larger biopharma and investors to fund late-stage studies and accelerate commercialization.
